description: Package-only variant of the score-leading fx2 sidecar byte-split direct/extra/page-match candidate. The decoded cmix binary and english.dic.cmix payload are preserved; cmix.xz is recompressed with xz x86 BCJ filtering.

build.packaging: Minified Python wrapper with BCJ-filtered cmix.xz and cmix-compressed english.dic.

basis: The x86 BCJ filter reduces the counted executable payload without changing the decompressed sidecar cmix binary or compression algorithm.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary

64k_inherited_from_parent.roundtrip_basis: Decoded cmix binary, dictionary payload, and wrapper are byte-identical to the current-driver verified parent package.

1m_inherited_from_parent.roundtrip_basis: Decoded cmix binary, dictionary payload, and wrapper are byte-identical to the current-driver verified parent package.

verdict: Promote as a package-only improvement over the current old-sidecar min package. It preserves archive behavior and lowers the counted payload by 5828 bytes.
